name: Main Street USD
oneLiner: msUSD is Main Street's USDC-backed dollar stablecoin minted 1:1 by KYC-verified users; delta-neutral options yield accrues separately via the msY token.
collateral: USDC reserves backing unstaked msUSD 1:1; delta-neutral options-box yield accrues to the separate msY strategy token after users stake msUSD
pegMechanism: KYC-verified users mint and redeem msUSD 1:1 against USDC through Main Street contracts, while staking msUSD into msY is a separate NAV-appreciating yield path
